primary_statement: In the zero-field nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic Ising model on Z^3, with the free infinite-volume state, the signed coupling g(beta)=sum U4(0,x2,x3,x4)/(chi(beta)^2 xi(beta)^3) does not tend to zero as beta increases to beta_c from below.
exact_nonvanishing_quantifier: There exist epsilon>0 and beta_n increasing to beta_c with -g(beta_n)>=epsilon. A positive liminf or a uniform lower bound for every endpoint quadruple is stronger.
